title: Learned (fitted) dictionary vs random dictionary: is the frozen sparse ceiling the family's or the random basis's?

device._note: whitening and ridge on numpy CPU (M107 arithmetic); encode and the k-means fit on the GPU ('cuda' = ROCm/HIP). HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1, device_count 1, gcnArchName gfx1201.

parity_guard.feature: CLS token concatenated with the mean of the patch tokens

sparse.random_dictionary: M108 arm (a) exact: prefix of the seeded permutation of the shared 8192-whitened-patch pool
sparse.learned_dictionary: mini-batch k-means (VQ) centroids fitted on a registered 2,000,000-whitened-patch pool (3,000 train images, seed 22); 60 iterations, batch 131072, moving-average lr = 1/(1+it), dead-centroid reinit from the pool; same 108-dim whitened space as random atoms
sparse.topk_codes: keep the top-64 nearest-atom triangle activations per patch, zero the rest, pool; the code is zero-padded to the full atom dimension so per-image MACs are the SAME as arm (b) (sparse code, dense storage). Arm (c) asks whether top-k sparsity helps accuracy at matched cost. A compact sparse code + sparse ridge accumulator and approximate neighbor search (the genuine head/encode cost cuts) are deferred

head._note: M108's chosen head constant (penalty 1.0), applied unchanged to all three arms.

gate.kill_switch_1_learned_lifts_ceiling: if learned-3072 does not beat random-3072 overall by >= +0.01 at matched atoms and MACs, the random basis is not the binding constraint and the learned-dictionary thesis fails at this budget
gate.kill_switch_2_vs_dense_at_or_below: learned-3072 (254.6M total MACs) vs the best M107 sealed dense point at-or-below that cost (dense r42: 0.1972 at 215.6M); if learned-3072 < 0.1972 + 0.01, no global accuracy win is licensed
gate.registered_prediction: k-means centroids remove a random draw's Poisson sampling noise, so learned should beat random by a modest amount (+1 to +4 points); whether it clears +0.01 is the open question; the dense-at-cost win (KS2) is not expected to be large because the global 3072-atom arm is MAC-bound
